event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Mega-cap tech cracked, defensives absorbed the money.
Nov Consumer Confidence printed 103.3 vs 92.5 fc, but the tape traded the AI complex: XLK -3.26% and SOXX -8.27% overwhelmed the rotation, and DIA +0.79% closing above 50,000 is a value/dividend bid, not risk appetite. SPY and QQQ now sit below their 200-day MAs — that is a CTA sell trigger, and with QQQ -11.53% over 20 days the momentum unwind is doing the damage, not the macro data.

INDICES — VIX 26.6, +4.5pts vs its 22.1 20-day MA.
Ranked: DIA +0.79%, IWM +0.53%, SPY -0.49%, QQQ -1.99%, SOXX -8.27%. Small beat large by 1.02pp. Crude +1.55% (USO) was the standout cross-asset gainer while gold -2.27% and silver -5.32% were crushed. Both SPY and QQQ closed below the 200-day MA — flag as an active CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SOXX traded 1.6x average on a -8.27% day: textbook distribution in semis.
QQQ's 1.0x on -1.99% is moderate conviction selling, while SPY's 38th-percentile 5-day outflow (-$1,914mm) says institutions are not chasing the dip. Breadth diverges: 345/156 advancers, 55% above the 50-DMA, up/down volume only 1.04, and 30 new 60d highs vs 9 lows — participation is broader than the index suggests, so this is a mega-cap unwind, not a broad collapse.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +2.95%, XLP Staples +1.66%, XLRE Real Estate +1.31%, XLE Energy +0.97%, XLF Financials +0.83%, XLC Comms +0.82%, XLY Discretionary +0.68%, XLB Materials +0.54%, XLU Utilities +0.18%, XLI Industrials -0.53%, XLK Technology -3.26%.
Top industries XBI +6.56% and IBB +5.17%; bottom DRAM -9.22% and WGMI -8.28%. Five-day flows put XLC +$280mm (92p) and XLP +$231mm (83p) at the top against XLE -$1,142mm (2p) and XLV -$884mm (2p) — healthcare's price leadership contradicts its flow bleed, so that bid is short-covering, not conviction. Money-out is semis and energy; money-in is biotech and staples. Rotation-state: 'AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation'.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.80 and IWM 3.36 scream protection demand; QQQ's 0.89 is comparatively complacent even with ATM IV at 31.2%.
Positive skew on SPY +11.7% and QQQ +12.8% confirms put premium. VIXEQ 50.0 vs VIX 26.6 is a 23-point gap — high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape, not a correlated macro one; VVIX 117.4 above its 109.3 MA keeps tail hedging bid.

CROSS-ASSET — Silver -5.32% (SLV PCR 1.35) against gold -2.27% and the dollar -0.50% is the tell: precious metals are being liquidated for cash, not traded on the dollar.
Next FOMC is Dec 9, 2026; Polymarket prices a 25bp hike at 94% YES (+2pp in 5 days) versus 4% for no change — the market is positioned for tightening, which explains the real-asset unwind.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 58.5, Neutral.
Movers: TXN -11.25%, MU -11.01% on a tickeron piece flagging mid-December FQ1 guidance, MRVL -9.10% on no company-specific filing. QQQE vol 3.6x on -0.94% is distribution, and MDT -4.56% on 2.6x is a distribution print in medtech despite XLV's bid. Watch tomorrow: IWM at 3.36 PCR and 269 maxpain (crowded hedging, squeeze fuel into tomorrow's Core PCE 0.3% fc); GLD with IV at 27.4% and maxpain 335 after a -12.58% 20-day break; SOXX 1.6x volume on -8.27% — the distribution volume there decides whether the flip turns into something worse.
